newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FPH 96/97 1st half net 970.643 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: FPH 96/97 1st half net 970.643 mln pesos.

text.p: First Philippine Holdings Corp posted a net income of 970.643 million pesos in the first six months ended December 31, documents submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday showed.
Revenues reached 1.902 billion pesos, while costs and expenses amounted to 819.948 million pesos.
The company did not give comparative year-ago figures.
It reported net income of 1.293 billion pesos in fiscal year 1995-1996 ended June 30. Turnover reached 3.003 billion pesos during the same period.
First Philippine Holdings is a subsidiary of conglomerate Benpres Holdings Corp, and is engaged mainly in power generation and distribution.
